name: ScreenPrintFilter
description: Free online halftone dot filter for images. Convert any image into screen print-ready halftone patterns directly in your browser.

features.name: Halftone Conversion
features.description: Convert images to halftone dot patterns with customizable parameters

features.name: Multiple Dot Shapes

features.name: Custom Parameters

features.name: Privacy Focused
